name: 48076-longctxdecode-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), driver 570.195.03.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine on one card.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads (GQA 4:1), head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, rope llama3 x8, max_position_embeddings 131072, bf16, 8.03B params = 16.1 GB; KV 128 KiB per token. Geometry is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 32, bounded at 160 requests (5 waves of 32) with a 2700 s safety cap, warmup the first 40% (= 64, two whole waves) and cooldown the last 20% (= 32, one whole wave), both by REQUEST count (`mode: requests`, not seconds), seed static 48076. Both phase counts must EXCEED the 32 streams or guidellm's overlap selection discards nothing at that end. Read the scored population off `request_latency.successful.count` rather than by subtracting the phases.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, NO prefix bucket. Prompt EXACTLY 8192 tokens and output EXACTLY 1024 (min = max on both), greedy (temperature 0.0), and the backend forces ignore_eos with max_tokens so every request emits all 1024. The prompt is rendered through the chat template, which adds ~10-12 tokens, so the engine sees ~8202 rather than 8192. Prompt text is faker-generated prose and nothing here depends on its content.
purpose: A long-document analysis assistant on one GPU, serving 32 concurrent users book-length prompts with full-page answers.
launch:
# Engine arguments for the pinned commit, fed to AsyncEngineArgs rather than to a CLI: an unknown
# key from a later vLLM is a TypeError at engine construction. Every key must be top-level and
# every value must fit on one line.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
attention-backend: TRITON_ATTN
max-model-len: 16384
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
max-num-seqs: 128
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
